decisions.reason: Because this GIS solution platform stayed visible beyond launch and fits the firm's core integration strategy, its results likely met aspiration levels well enough that a medium-sized firm with some innovative slack would keep it, though platform products remain resource-intensive.

Mobile field data capture is close to the firm's established geospatial offer and customer needs, and its continued dedicated presentation suggests satisfactory performance relative to aspirations, reducing pressure to redeploy resources.

The explicit 2019 version update indicates ongoing development and customer relevance, so under a behavioral-theory view the product appears to have cleared aspiration thresholds and is unlikely to be dropped soon.
